93.body:
## Founder correction — CapabilityDeficit is now the key seam

This PR is closer to the founder's intended morphogenesis than the literal biological/organizational lines because it already preserves persistent goals and `capability-deficit` records.

Alfonso's 2026-09-09 clarification makes the intended next seam explicit:

```text
persistent founder goal
-> detect discrepancy / blocker
-> CapabilityDeficit
-> resourceful Capability Genesis
   -> existing capability
   -> composition/reconfiguration
   -> commodity/open source
   -> API/plugin/service/model
   -> authorized computer use
   -> small generated tool
   -> coding agent/team
   -> OMNIMORPH if organization is actually needed
   -> new architecture only if residual deficit remains
-> sandbox / adversarial test / independent verification
-> bounded capability attachment
-> resume the ORIGINAL goal
-> real outcome / reconciliation
```

Governing rule: **Preserve the effect. Do not literalize the metaphor.** A science-fiction founder request is an outcome specification: preserve the aspiration, compile it into observable effects, and use real mechanisms to approximate/achieve it without fabricating capability.

Please treat `CapabilityDeficit` as the canonical trigger for this resourceful resolution loop. Tool construction/acquisition is a subtask; it must not falsely close the original mission.

Existing limitations in this PR remain: synthetic founder signer, trusted-process sandbox, explicit ticks, two built-in functions, no real founder auth, no 24/7 service, no arbitrary-code isolation, no real-world outcome. This correction creates no production authority. It clarifies where the Goal Chase should eventually connect once the shared repair/adoption path is ready.
93.author: dababiyoda

93.body:
### Founder correction — CapabilityDeficit now routes through the Effect Compiler

This Goal Chase PR is the key future integration seam for `INTENT-0030` / draft #99.

When Goal Chase records a `CapabilityDeficit`, the intended response is **not** “instantiate biological/organizational morphogenesis.” It is:

`CapabilityDeficit -> define observable target effect -> inventory existing capabilities -> search conventional/commodity/open-source/API/plugin/service/computer-use routes -> extract/recombine mechanisms if useful -> build only the residual missing capability -> sandbox/test -> verify -> attach under explicit authority -> resume the original durable goal`

The original goal remains durable while capability formation proceeds. Completing a tool build is not goal completion; the mission resumes and must still reconcile against reality.

This is the founder's intended functional meaning of morphogenesis: the institution changes its functional form/resource set so it can keep going.

No current sandbox closure count, synthetic founder identity, external-channel restriction, merge/deploy state, or authority changes. Runtime ownership for Capability Genesis remains a later convergence decision.
93.author: dababiyoda

94.body:
## Founder correction for CMC / Phase-4 reconciliation

Apply `INTENT-0029` before any continuation of this branch.

**Preserve the founder's desired effect; do not literalize the morphogenesis metaphor.** Organizational morphology is a candidate mechanism, not the destination.

The real higher-order requirement is: when a persistent mission encounters a verified capability deficit, UNIIMENTE should resourcefully discover/acquire/compose/adapt/build the missing function, verify it, attach it under bounded authority, and resume the original mission.

Therefore the existing selector's alternatives should be interpreted broadly. `single model/tool`, `existing workflow`, `static DurableWorkflow`, `fixed specialists`, `human escalation`, and `temporary organization` are not merely organizational baselines; future comparisons should also admit mature commodity/open-source/API/plugin/computer-use/coding-agent routes where applicable.

Retain the protected evidence-appraisal work, CMC verification hardening, dissent, static baseline, and organization-design experiments. Do not treat a winning organization topology as proof of morphogenesis unless it actually closes the named underlying capability/outcome better than simpler routes.

This clarification changes no authority or deployment state.
94.author: dababiyoda

94.body:
### Founder correction — inherit INTENT-0030 from the organizational stack

Because this PR is stacked on #92, it inherits the 2026-09-09 founder correction in draft #99:

> **Preserve the intended effect. Do not literalize the metaphor. Search reality before inventing architecture.**

Retain the protected evidence appraisal, independent verification, static-vs-organizational comparisons, ownership boundaries, and failure records. But OMNIMORPH/organization hypotheses remain **optional mechanisms** inside broader functional Capability Genesis.

A future Phase-4 experiment should not ask only, “which organization should UNIIMENTE instantiate?” It should first ask, “what observable effect/CapabilityDeficit must be closed, and what is the cheapest real mechanism that closes it?” Static workflow, direct capability, external/open-source tools, APIs/plugins/services, computer use, narrow code, and no-instantiation remain legitimate winners.

No current `CMC`, VDM, LIVE/HARDENED, authority, merge, deployment, or activation state changes.
